api.name: AWOZ-1227 E1 Sharing -- psp7-demo-recipient
api.description: Channel E-1 egress route for recipient psp7-demo-recipient. GENERATED by scripts/29_gen_gravitee_route_family.py from route-table.yaml, policy-classes.yaml, recipients.yaml and this recipient's own issued credential endpoint. Do not edit by hand -- regenerate. One route per recipient because the sharing host is per-recipient and the platform validates the host/token binding (docs/11 B-42, docs/10 D-9).

_rationale.note: Presence and well-formedness only. The gateway does NOT validate the token -- Databricks does, at step 4. This is the key architectural principle in §1 and the reason the plans are KEY_LESS.
Cross-referenced against system.access.audit by T-11. The header must be ADDED on the request so it appears in both logs; a response-side correlation id correlates nothing.

request.name: CIDR allow-list (agency IP ranges)
request.description: CONOPS 3.1 - IP allow-listing. DISABLED for this recipient by design.

_rationale.disabled_list_contents_note: The list of a DISABLED policy is inert, but it is still read by anyone auditing this file, and a disabled policy carrying a permissive CIDR is one toggle away from a vacuous control (B-47). It is therefore left empty unless the local-test accommodation was asked for.
_rationale.enabled_false_because: This recipient declares ip_access_list.mode = 'NOT_APPLIED_BY_DESIGN' in iac/config/recipients.yaml. The reason given there applies at the gateway too: an allow-list denial and an entitlement denial are the same observation from the client's side, so a gateway allow-list in front of this recipient would let T-04 and T-21 pass without touching the mechanism they name (§12.9's silent negative with the sign flipped, the B-40 class).
_rationale.recipient_reason: THIS IS NOT AN OVERSIGHT AND MUST NOT BE "FIXED". This is the recipient Task 1.7 reads through to rebuild T-04. An IP access list on it would deny the read, and an allow-list denial and an entitlement denial are the same observation from the client's side. T-04 would then pass for the wrong reason: the column would be unreachable because the NETWORK refused, not because the column is outside the grant. That is §12.9's silent negative with the sign flipped -- a test passing without touching the mechanism it names.
_rationale.emitted_disabled_rather_than_omitted_bec: An absent control and a decided-against control look identical in a deployed gateway. Only one of them is a decision, and the definition should say which.

_rationale.key_note: Keyed on the Authorization header because the plans are KEY_LESS, so Gravitee has no subscription to key on. This is a per-CREDENTIAL limit, which is the per-consumer limit §3.1 asks for only while one credential means one consumer. If a recipient's credential is shared between two consuming systems the limit is shared too, and that is not visible at the edge. Recorded as a limitation of the KEY_LESS choice, not a defect.

plans.description: KEY_LESS: authorization is the Delta Sharing bearer token, validated by Databricks, not by Gravitee plan security (§1 key architectural principle). Consequence recorded in policy-classes.yaml class A key_note: the rate limit is keyed on the Authorization header, so it is per-CREDENTIAL and not per-consumer if a credential is shared.

_not_built.detail: This flow is generated onto a CANDIDATE path. If the path is wrong the selector matches nothing, the request falls to the catch-all, and the refusal will look like an edge control working. Do not report a refusal on this route as enforcement until the path is settled.
